content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fairfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience to sit for the PMP exam. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—your background in formal education and documented hours leading projects determines whether you qualify. Contact Granite PM Academy to verify your credentials before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Fairfield-focused program delivers the PMI-required contact hours through interactive, real-world scenarios. Attend sessions on your schedule and earn your certificate of completion upon finishing the course.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the examination fee. You'll provide your education, experience, and course-completion documentation. PMI reviews and approves your application, confirming you're eligible to test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation support helps you review key domains and practice test-style questions. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll sit for a computer-based exam that assesses your mastery of project-management knowledge and practice.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout a three-year renewal cycle. Pursue learning, volunteer work, and certifications that keep your skills current. Renew on schedule to maintain active PMP status and demonstrate ongoing expertise.
